headline: Updated 19:10: the internal CRM update ran overnight and passed its technical checks; a founder's hands-on test is next.
items: The internal CRM update ran overnight and its technical run was accepted after security and quality reviews.
Saving new records is now switched on in the internal CRM, on the local machine only.
A founder's own hands-on test of the new Add screens is the last step before product acceptance.
Follow-up improvements found during the run are listed for the next update.
The Tech team filed its status for Saturday.
